title: Windows File and Directory Permissions Remove Inheritance
author: Teoderick Contreras, Splunk
description: The following analytic detects the removal of permission inheritance using ICACLS. This analytic identifies instances where ICACLS is used to remove permission inheritance from files or directories. The /inheritance:r flag, which strips inherited permissions while optionally preserving or altering explicit permissions, is monitored to detect changes that may restrict access or establish isolated permission configurations. Removing inheritance can be a legitimate administrative action but may also indicate an attempt to conceal malicious activity or bypass inherited security controls.
